# Command line

`stitch` is StitchCraft's command-line tool. Each section shows the command's own `--help`.

## stitch

```text
stitch: the StitchCraft command-line tool

Usage: stitch <COMMAND>

Commands:
  testsheet  Write a machine-checkpoint test sheet (docs/src/plan/machine-testing.md)
  inspect    Read a machine file (PES, PEC or DST) and describe it: size, stitches, threads, stitch lengths
  profiles   List the built-in machine profiles
  explain    Explain a diagnostic code, such as SC-W0702
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version

Exit status: 0 done (warnings allowed) · 1 the design or file has errors (nothing written) · 2 usage
error · 3 a file could not be read or written.

Coming with the roadmap (docs/src/plan/roadmap.md):
  stitch preview design.pes -o design.png                   (M2)
  stitch plan design.svg -o design.pes                      (M3)
  stitch export design.vectorcraft -o design.pes            (M6)
```

## stitch testsheet

```text
Write a machine-checkpoint test sheet (docs/src/plan/machine-testing.md)

Usage: stitch testsheet [OPTIONS] [SHEET]

Arguments:
  [SHEET]
          The sheet, such as TS-01 (see --list)

Options:
      --list
          List the test sheets and exit

  -p, --profile <PROFILE>
          The machine profile, such as brother-200x200 (see `stitch profiles`)

  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          The file to write

      --format <FORMAT>
          The file format; by default the output file's extension decides

          Possible values:
          - pes: Brother PES, version 1
          - dst: Tajima DST

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## stitch inspect

```text
Read a machine file (PES, PEC or DST) and describe it: size, stitches, threads, stitch lengths

Usage: stitch inspect [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>
          The machine file

Options:
  -p, --profile <PROFILE>
          Also check the design against a machine profile, such as brother-200x200 (see `stitch profiles`)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## stitch profiles

```text
List the built-in machine profiles

Usage: stitch profiles

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## stitch explain

```text
Explain a diagnostic code, such as SC-W0702

Usage: stitch explain <CODE>

Arguments:
  <CODE>
          The code

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## stitch help

```text
Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Usage: stitch help [COMMAND]...

Arguments:
  [COMMAND]...
          Print help for the subcommand(s)
```
